rows.reason: Primary decode improves about2x but full-validation batch1 exposes a confirmed resident decode regression (paired geometric latency +4.96%, speedup95% CI0.9222-0.9842). Offload batch1 is slower in all three pairs but its wide interval crosses1; classify it within_noise, not a confirmed regression. Reject this unconditional append policy as a scaling tradeoff and investigate shape-selective reuse.
